review: Keep both return leg and rest in arithmetic.
Explicitly judge supplied proposal before revising it.
Any adjustment must satisfy both caps; numeric spending envelopes are not verified real-world prices.
Two flat Markdown bullets per actor, without outside greeting or conclusion.
No invented city-specific location, quoted vendor price, shared past, or speech for another actor.
Facilitated actors independently check arithmetic instead of treating preceding actor as authoritative.
Persona differences judged in wording/activity emphasis, not as permission to violate hard constraints.
limitations: Synthetic explicit arithmetic task is easier than open-ended route generation; compare separately with original open-ended case.
